_note: 360-degree path analyzer. Limits and statuses are data; the prompt is path_analyzer.md.
_min_fit_note: A suggested field is kept only with at least min_fit_evidence fit items in fit_evidence_statuses, each citing the student. Fewer or zero paths is the correct answer when the fit is weak; never pad to max_paths.
_education_note: How an education record reads as path evidence: catalog labels, never codes. Hidden fields are internal levels; status codes have no catalog list, so their words live here.
_needs_education_note: When a chat-requested analysis cannot place the student, PAI posts one short message saying what it needs. needs_education_by_level picks the message from the level the education record names; a level not listed (or none) asks for the education itself. Only runs the student asked for in chat (needs_education_post_reasons) post it; the Paths page says it on its own.

needs_education_messages.group: Which group are you in, Pre-Engineering, Pre-Medical, ICS, I.Com or FA?
needs_education_messages.subjects: Which A-level subjects are you taking?
needs_education_messages.field: Which field are you studying, for example Computer Science or BBA?
needs_education_messages.education: What are you studying now, and in which group or field?
